tools.name: search_cards
tools.description: Search and filter the credit card catalog by bank, program, annual fee, card type, or credit range. Use this first when the user names a card or asks which card to choose; pass an ID returned here to get_card_details. Only search CardCurator credit-card and rewards questions.

tools.name: get_card_details
tools.description: Get full details for one CardCurator credit card, including credits, milestones, perks, APR offers, and portal values. Use only with a cardId returned by search_cards. Do not pass a card name, a natural-language question, or an ID invented by the model; call search_cards first.

tools.name: list_programs
tools.description: List all loyalty programs (credit card, airline, hotel) with type, currency, and points valuations.

tools.name: get_transfer_partners
tools.description: Get all transfer partners for a loyalty program, including transfer ratios and any active bonuses.

tools.name: get_active_transfer_bonuses
tools.description: Get all currently active transfer bonuses across all programs. Optionally filter by source program.

tools.name: get_award_chart
tools.description: Get award chart pricing for an airline loyalty program. Filter by cabin class or region.

tools.name: get_points_valuations
tools.description: Get cents-per-point valuations (baseline, floor, ceiling) for loyalty programs.

tools.name: search_cards_by_benefit
tools.description: Find credit cards by specific benefits, credits, or features. Use when asked "which cards have X credit/benefit?" Searches credit names, feature strings, and benefit categories. Returns cards ranked by total annual credit value.

tools.name: compare_cards
tools.description: Compare 2–4 credit cards side-by-side. Returns fees, earn rates, signup bonuses, credits, transfer partner counts, and portal values for each card, plus a highlight summary.

tools.name: recommend_category_cards
tools.description: Find the best credit cards for a specific spending category (e.g., groceries, dining, travel, gas, streaming). Returns cards ranked by earn rate for that category with effective annual fees.

tools.name: find_apr_cards
tools.description: Find credit cards with 0% APR promotional offers. Use when users ask about 0% APR cards, financing purchases interest-free, or balance transfer options. Sorted by longest duration first.

tools.name: find_balance_transfer_cards
tools.description: Find credit cards with 0% APR balance transfer offers. Optionally pass debtAmount and currentApr to calculate exact interest savings and net benefit for each card.

tools.name: get_bookable_partners
tools.description: Get which airlines can be booked (award flights) using a specific airline loyalty program's miles. Use when asked "which airlines can I book with United miles?" or "can I use Aeroplan for Lufthansa?". Distinct from transfer partners — this is about redemption.

tools.name: recommend_program_cards
tools.description: Recommend the best credit cards for a specific rewards program or issuer (e.g., "Chase", "Amex", "Delta", "Marriott", "Hyatt"). Returns cards ranked by overall value with top pick highlighted.
